annotations.title: How each forward pattern was measured

description: The ledger behind every forward claim: for each pattern, its definition, population, test period, base rate, rate among entities showing it, lift with its interval, median lead time, early and late halves (stability), precision at the top 1% against a conventional recency list at the same cut, the multiple-testing q value, and its status (VALIDATED, PRODUCTION, TESTING, PROSPECTIVE_ONLY, WEAK, REJECTED). Rejected patterns are listed on purpose: they are what DFX tested and found did not predict. Filter by vertical, status or signal key.
